repo.name: poetry
repo.description: Python packaging and dependency management made easy

readme.summary: Clear introduction and comprehensive configuration example, but lacks executable quick-start commands and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No quick-start section showing actual Poetry commands to initialize or use a project - the pyproject.toml example shows configuration but not how to actually run Poetry CLI commands like 'poetry init', 'poetry install', or 'poetry add'

injection_risks.description: The import_module function can pose a risk if the module name is not validated properly, potentially allowing for arbitrary code execution.
The getattr function can be used to access arbitrary attributes of an object, but in this case, it seems to be used with a validated module name.

critical_findings: Potential for arbitrary code execution through the import_module function
security.summary: The Poetry package has some security concerns related to potential injection risks and input validation issues, but overall it seems to be well-structured and secure.

common_complaints: Documentation gaps (configuration precedence, install vs update behavior unclear)
Bugs in core functionality (readme.text path handling, version parsing issues)
Backward compatibility breaks (lock file incompatibility between versions)
CLI usability issues (confusing command argument requirements)
Private repository handling errors (AssertionError in dependency resolution)
praise_themes: Recognition of Poetry as a valuable tool ("thank you for your great work")
Users proposing thoughtful feature requests with clear use cases
Engagement on feature discussions (multiple related issues show iterative feedback)
sentiment.summary: Poetry shows moderate community health with active engagement on both bugs and features, but documentation gaps and recent backward compatibility issues are causing user frustration.

red_flags: lacking in encouragement for new contributors
communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful and technically sound, but could improve in terms of clarity, patience, and welcomingness to create a more supportive community.

concerns: No commits in past 6 months despite last commit being recent (2026-02-01)
578 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months indicates no issue triage
Zero active contributors in past 6 months
No merged PRs in past 6 months suggests no active development or code review
positive_signals: Recent commit timestamp suggests repository exists and had some activity
maintenance.summary: Poetry appears abandoned with stagnant development, no issue resolution, and zero active contributors despite a recent timestamp anomaly.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-organized and comprehensive, but lacks explicit breaking change markers and migration guides.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The documentation is clear and well-structured, but lacks a quick start guide and troubleshooting section.

Communication: sometimes dismissive of repeated questions
